scale_cues: Square white dinner plate about 25-27 cm across fills most of the frame; I judged the rice mound and chicken pieces against the plate width. There was no cutlery or hand to check scale against.
assumptions: The dark charred pieces on the left and center are chicken. They could be pork or grilled eggplant, which would change the protein a lot.
The pale grain is brown rice. It could also be quinoa or farro, which have similar calories.
The glossy leaves suggest a dressing or oil of about 1 tablespoon or less.
Only food on the plate is counted. There is no visible drink.
The photo is taken from overhead, so mound height is estimated, not measured.
